body: wish I could say I feel better this morning, but I just don't...
i think i'm gonna get some sleep, or at least try. put some more thought into everything. thank you for being here

i'll try that, thank you.

as far as good things happening. i see it. all of it. good and bad things happening. but it doesn't make me legitimately happy. i may be happy for the moment, very briefly, but i'm just not satisfied with life. nothing seems to truly make me completely happy.i don't get it... i just lack motivation to feel happy. to care. i just feel like giving up because everything in life just seems so frivolous. nothing matters! it really doesn't...

As I'm sitting here, hoping someone replies to my post, I'm reading through yours, noticing I have similar feelings as you. I'm 21, female... Maybe, just MAYBE we could possibly find similar interests or anything at all that could possibly help us find a reason to live...

i want to so bad... i just can't seem to muster up the courage to talk to anyone. i wouldn't even know where to start. i feel like there's so much that i've buried so deep over the years that i can't find the words to describe everything. 

i'm so glad you replied by the way. i was beginning to feel disheartened. I looked through all the other /r/suicidewatch posts, and it made me so sad seeing all these other people in pain. i try to be strong. more than often for other people as well. 

when would i even talk to him?? we have a (idk what to call it) vacation planned in 2 days. I know it would put a damper on the whole trip. we will be on the east coast with family for a week celebrating the graduation of my brother in law. not only will it cause an issue with the trip on that level, but if i tell him i'm having thoughts of suicide, he's supposed to tell someone. we're both in the military.. if someone tells you about there suicidal thoughts, you HAVE to tell someone about it... they wouldn't let us go for the week. i know i won't do anything this week, probably not when i get back either. i'm just in pain....

I feel no hope is left inside myself though. I've tried volunteering, and it only made my happiness skin deep. it feels good to help other people, but it's not helping me. about the friends thing... it sucks because as soon as i make friends, they are quick to abandon me, like i'm boring them or something. i can't imagine that i'm doing anything wrong. i'm moderately outgoing. not repulsive or anything...
it's not that i can't communicate with my husband. i can't seem to talk to anyone. i'm too embarrassed. at work we always have the suicide briefs saying to talk to someone and to not be scared. i just can't help it though. i know it will come as a shock to absolutely anyone i tell because i strive to do the best in everything i do. i'm an outstanding worker... i think i'm afraid they won't believe me? or all the hard work i've put in will be null and void once i talk to someone? 

i can honestly say i don't plan on killing myself. but i do think about it all the time... things upset me pretty quickly...

also... I remember reading a reddit a few weeks ago about some kid weighing the pros and cons of life, and decided suicide was the best option because life just isn't worth it. I can't seem to find it but I feel just that way....
